title: Five short conversations: plans and places
instr: For each question, choose the correct answer. You will hear five short conversations.

script.t: One. What time will they meet?
Shall we meet at the cinema at half past six?
The film starts at seven, so that's a bit early. And I finish football at six fifteen.
OK. Let's say a quarter to seven, then.
Perfect.
Two. Where did the woman leave her umbrella?
Oh no, I haven't got my umbrella. I had it on the bus.
Are you sure? You used it when we walked from the bus stop to the bank.
You're right. So I must have left it in the bank, next to the chair where I waited.
Three. What will the boy buy for his sister?
What are you getting your sister for her birthday? A book?
She's got hundreds of books. I wanted to get her a scarf, but they were too expensive.
What about a plant for her room?
Good idea. She loves plants. I'll get one this afternoon.
Four. How will the man travel to the airport?
My flight is at eight tomorrow morning. Is there a train to the airport?
Yes, but the first one is at seven. That's too late. A taxi is expensive. Why don't you take the airport bus? It leaves at five thirty.
Good, I'll do that.
Five. What is the weather like now?
Is it still raining, Mum?
No, it stopped about ten minutes ago. It's cloudy now, but they said it'll be sunny this afternoon.
Great, so we can go to the beach later.

items.q: What time will they meet?

ev.s: Let's say a quarter to seven, then.

items.why: Họ chốt bảy giờ kém mười lăm (a quarter to seven).

wrong.A: 6.30 là đề nghị đầu tiên, cậu bé thấy hơi sớm.
wrong.C: Bảy giờ là giờ phim bắt đầu.

items.q: Where did the woman leave her umbrella?

ev.s: So I must have left it in the bank

items.why: Bà nhận ra đã để quên ô trong ngân hàng.

wrong.A: Bà tưởng để trên xe buýt, nhưng sau đó vẫn dùng ô.
wrong.B: Bà dùng ô khi đi từ bến xe buýt đến ngân hàng.

items.q: What will the boy buy for his sister?
items.why: Cậu đồng ý mua một chậu cây.

wrong.A: Chị đã có hàng trăm cuốn sách.
wrong.C: Khăn quàng quá đắt.

items.q: How will the man travel to the airport?
items.why: Ông nghe lời khuyên và đi xe buýt sân bay.

wrong.A: Taxi đắt, người phụ nữ khuyên không đi.
wrong.B: Chuyến tàu đầu tiên lúc bảy giờ, quá muộn.

items.q: What is the weather like now?
items.why: Bây giờ trời nhiều mây.

wrong.B: Mưa đã tạnh mười phút trước.
wrong.C: Trời nắng là dự báo cho buổi chiều.

title: Five short conversations: shopping and food
instr: For each question, choose the correct answer. You will hear five short conversations.

script.t: One. How much did the girl pay for her shoes?
Nice shoes! Were they expensive?
They were forty dollars, but there was a sale, so I only paid twenty-five.
That's cheap. My shoes cost fifty.
Two. What will they have for dinner?
Shall we have fish tonight?
We had fish yesterday. What about chicken?
There's no chicken in the fridge. But there are some eggs and vegetables. I can make an omelette.
Fine, let's have that.
Three. Which bag does the woman buy?
Can I help you?
Yes, I like that black bag, but it's a bit small. Have you got it in a bigger size?
Only in brown. Or there's this grey one, the same size as the black one.
I'll take the brown one, then.
Four. Where is the supermarket?
Excuse me, is the supermarket near the post office?
It was, but it moved last year. Now it's opposite the hospital, next to the big car park.
Thanks.
Five. What did the man forget to buy?
Did you get everything? Milk, bread and coffee?
I got the milk and the coffee. Oh no, the bread! I'll go back.
Don't worry, we've got some rice. We can have that.

items.q: How much did the girl pay for her shoes?
items.why: Có giảm giá nên cô chỉ trả 25 đô.

wrong.B: 40 đô là giá gốc.
wrong.C: 50 đô là giá giày của người đàn ông.

items.q: What will they have for dinner?
items.why: Họ chốt món trứng tráng.

wrong.A: Hôm qua đã ăn cá.
wrong.C: Tủ lạnh hết gà.

items.q: Which bag does the woman buy?

ev.s: I'll take the brown one, then.

items.why: Bà mua túi màu nâu vì nó to hơn.

wrong.A: Túi xám cùng cỡ với túi đen, vẫn nhỏ.
wrong.B: Túi đen hơi nhỏ.

items.q: Where is the supermarket?
items.why: Siêu thị giờ ở đối diện bệnh viện.

wrong.B: Siêu thị ở cạnh bãi đỗ xe, không ở trong bãi.
wrong.C: Đó là chỗ cũ trước khi chuyển.

items.q: What did the man forget to buy?
items.why: Ông quên mua bánh mì.

wrong.A: Ông đã mua cà phê.
wrong.B: Ông đã mua sữa.

title: Five short conversations: school and work
instr: For each question, choose the correct answer. You will hear five short conversations.

script.t: One. Which subject does the girl like best?
Is maths still your favourite subject?
Not any more. The new teacher is too strict. I liked history for a while, but now it's art. I can't wait for Thursday's lesson!
Two. When is the woman's job interview?
Is your interview on Monday?
It was, but they changed it to Wednesday. The manager is away until Tuesday.
Good luck on Wednesday, then.
Three. How does the boy get to school now?
Do you still walk to school, Tuan?
No, my mum used to drive me, but now I cycle. It's faster than walking, and I can stop at the shop on the way.
Four. What does the man need?
Excuse me, can I borrow your pen?
Sorry, I've only got a pencil. Do you need some paper too?
No, I've got paper. I'll use a pencil, that's fine.
Five. Where is the class party?
Is the class party in Room 5?
No, Room 5 is too small. It's in the library on the first floor. Room 9 is free too, but it hasn't got any speakers for music.

items.q: Which subject does the girl like best?
items.why: Giờ môn cô thích nhất là mỹ thuật.

wrong.A: Toán không còn là môn yêu thích ("Not any more").
wrong.C: Cô từng thích lịch sử một thời gian.

items.q: When is the woman's job interview?
items.why: Buổi phỏng vấn đã chuyển sang thứ Tư.

wrong.B: Thứ Hai là ngày cũ.
wrong.C: Thứ Ba là hạn người quản lý đi vắng.

items.q: How does the boy get to school now?
items.why: Bây giờ Tuấn đạp xe.

wrong.A: Mẹ từng chở cậu, nhưng giờ thì không.
wrong.C: Cậu không còn đi bộ.

items.q: What does the man need?

ev.s: I'll use a pencil, that's fine.

items.why: Ông cần thứ để viết và chấp nhận dùng bút chì.

wrong.A: Ông đã có giấy.
wrong.B: Ông muốn mượn bút, không mua bút mới, và chấp nhận bút chì.

items.q: Where is the class party?

ev.s: It's in the library on the first floor.

items.why: Tiệc lớp ở thư viện tầng một.

wrong.B: Phòng 5 quá nhỏ.
wrong.C: Phòng 9 trống nhưng không có loa.

title: Five short conversations: home and family
instr: For each question, choose the correct answer. You will hear five short conversations.

script.t: One. Who is the girl going to visit?
Are you going to your grandparents' this weekend?
Not this time. They're coming to us next month. I'm going to see my aunt in Da Nang. My cousin will meet me at the station.
Two. What is the man's new flat like?
How's your new flat? Is it near the river?
No, my old one was. This one's in the centre. It's quite small, but it's very quiet.
Three. Which room does the woman want to paint?
Are you going to paint the kitchen this weekend?
I did the kitchen last month. The bathroom is OK. It's the bedroom that looks old now. I'm going to paint it yellow.
Four. What is the boy's pet?
Is that your dog in the photo?
No, that's my neighbour's. I wanted a dog, but our flat is too small. So I've got a rabbit. My sister has a cat.
Five. What time does the boy's mum get home on Fridays?
Your mum usually gets home at five, doesn't she?
Yes, but on Fridays she finishes work late, at seven, so she gets home at half past seven. Dad comes home at six.

items.q: Who is the girl going to visit?

ev.s: I'm going to see my aunt in Da Nang.

items.why: Cô đi thăm dì ở Đà Nẵng.

wrong.A: Ông bà sẽ đến nhà cô vào tháng sau.
wrong.C: Em họ chỉ ra ga đón cô.

items.q: What is the man's new flat like?

ev.s: It's quite small, but it's very quiet.

items.why: Căn hộ mới rất yên tĩnh.

wrong.A: Căn hộ khá nhỏ.
wrong.B: Căn hộ cũ mới gần sông.

items.q: Which room does the woman want to paint?

ev.s: It's the bedroom that looks old now.

items.why: Bà sẽ sơn phòng ngủ.

wrong.B: Phòng tắm vẫn ổn.
wrong.C: Bếp đã sơn tháng trước.

items.q: What is the boy's pet?
items.why: Cậu nuôi một con thỏ.

wrong.A: Con chó trong ảnh là của hàng xóm.
wrong.B: Con mèo là của chị gái cậu.

items.q: What time does the boy's mum get home on Fridays?

ev.s: so she gets home at half past seven

items.why: Thứ Sáu mẹ về lúc bảy rưỡi.

wrong.A: Năm giờ là giờ về thường ngày, không phải thứ Sáu.
wrong.C: Sáu giờ là giờ bố về.

title: Five short conversations: free time
instr: For each question, choose the correct answer. You will hear five short conversations.

script.t: One. What sport does the woman do now?
Do you still play tennis?
No, I hurt my arm last year. I tried running, but I didn't enjoy it. Now I go swimming three times a week.
Two. Which film will they watch?
Shall we watch the space film?
I've seen it. What about the comedy with the dog?
My brother said it was boring. Let's see the new cartoon.
OK.
Three. What did the man do last weekend?
Did you go camping last weekend?
We planned to, but it rained. So we went to a museum. Next weekend we want to go fishing.
Four. How many people are coming to the party?
How many people did you invite? Twenty?
Twenty, yes, but five can't come. So fifteen people are coming.
Five. What instrument is the girl learning?
Are you still having piano lessons?
I stopped those. I'm learning the guitar now. My friend plays the drums, and we want to start a band.

items.q: What sport does the woman do now?

ev.s: Now I go swimming three times a week.

items.why: Bây giờ bà đi bơi ba lần một tuần.

wrong.B: Bà thôi chơi tennis vì đau tay.
wrong.C: Bà thử chạy nhưng không thích.

items.q: Which film will they watch?
items.why: Họ chốt xem phim hoạt hình mới.

wrong.A: Anh trai cô nói phim hài đó chán.
wrong.C: Cậu bé đã xem phim vũ trụ rồi.

items.q: What did the man do last weekend?

ev.s: So we went to a museum.

items.why: Trời mưa nên họ đi bảo tàng.

wrong.A: Câu cá là kế hoạch cuối tuần tới.
wrong.B: Họ định cắm trại nhưng trời mưa.

items.q: How many people are coming to the party?
items.why: Hai mươi người được mời, năm người không đến được, còn mười lăm.

wrong.B: Năm là số người không đến được.
wrong.C: Hai mươi là số người được mời.

items.q: What instrument is the girl learning?
items.why: Bây giờ cô học đàn ghi-ta.

wrong.A: Cô đã thôi học piano.
wrong.C: Bạn cô chơi trống.

title: Five short conversations: travel and town
instr: For each question, choose the correct answer. You will hear five short conversations.

script.t: One. Which platform does the train leave from?
Excuse me, is the train to Hanoi on platform three?
It usually is, but today it's on platform seven. Platform three is closed for repairs. The train to Vinh is on platform four.
Two. Where are they going to park?
Can we park in front of the shop?
No, it's not allowed there. The car park behind the bank is full on Saturdays. Let's park in the street next to the school.
Three. How long is the bus journey?
How long does the bus take to the beach? An hour?
It used to take an hour, but there's a new road now, so it's forty minutes. By car it's only twenty-five.
Four. What does the woman want to visit first?
Shall we go to the castle this morning?
It's very busy in the morning. Let's see the old bridge first and go to the castle after lunch. We can go to the market tomorrow.
Five. What is wrong with the hotel room?
Hello, I'm in room 12. The shower doesn't work.
I'm sorry. Is the air conditioning OK?
Yes, that's fine, and the TV works too. It's just the shower.

items.q: Which platform does the train leave from?

ev.s: but today it's on platform seven

items.why: Hôm nay tàu đi Hà Nội ở sân ga số bảy.

wrong.A: Sân ga ba đóng cửa sửa chữa.
wrong.B: Sân ga bốn dành cho tàu đi Vinh.

items.q: Where are they going to park?

ev.s: Let's park in the street next to the school.

items.why: Họ đỗ ở con phố cạnh trường học.

wrong.B: Bãi xe sau ngân hàng kín chỗ vào thứ Bảy.
wrong.C: Không được đỗ trước cửa hàng.

items.q: How long is the bus journey?
items.why: Có đường mới nên xe buýt đi mất bốn mươi phút.

wrong.A: Một giờ là thời gian trước kia.
wrong.B: Hai mươi lăm phút là đi bằng ô tô.

items.q: What does the woman want to visit first?

ev.s: Let's see the old bridge first

items.why: Bà muốn xem cây cầu cổ trước.

wrong.B: Lâu đài để sau bữa trưa.
wrong.C: Chợ để ngày mai.

items.q: What is wrong with the hotel room?
items.why: Vòi sen không hoạt động.

wrong.A: Ti vi vẫn hoạt động.
wrong.C: Điều hoà vẫn tốt.
